scene_description: A woman wearing an apron stands at a kitchen stove, stirring food in a pan. A basket of vegetables and fruits sits on the counter nearby. A ladle hangs on the wall behind her.

questions.question: Who is in the picture?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the person standing at the stove.

questions.question: What is the woman stirring?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at what is on the stove in front of the woman.

questions.question: What is in the basket on the counter?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the big basket sitting on the counter.

questions.question: Where is the woman standing?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the stove and counter around the woman.

questions.question: What is hanging on the wall?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the wall behind the woman near the top of the picture.
